chunk_map.heading: Without customer contact, agents build your guesses faster

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Referent resolution under a sequential deck read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L4 'Agents build them in days': 'them' = 'the team's guesses' in the same sentence chain; L6 'start there' = talking with customers every week, same sentence. Closest to violating: 'That sells less of this training' (L6), 'That' = starting with customer contact, named one clause earlier. Harm (unresolvable referent) absent.
Single-chunk file; grep for 'opening lecture|earlier file|previous lecture' in body: none. Harm (callback by position to another file) absent.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Every backward reference points at a beat that exists.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no 'the X you did/saw/caught' reference in body

rules_evaluated.evidence: L4-6: slide carries a full mechanism (cheap build, no evidence, guesses shipped) and a stated action (book interviews, sit in on calls, read last month's behaviour). Self-carrying; not a wait-state.

Header L1 'Without customer contact, agents build your guesses faster' vs L4 'With no fresh evidence from customers... Agents build them in days': header is the slide's claim and body supports it. Closest: L6 body turns to what to do first, which the header does not name, but does not contradict it.

L6 'That sells less of this training. It is still where to start.' is the nearest to a not-X-Z or pair tic but is two declaratives, no negated setup. L6 'Book the interviews, sit in on support calls, read what customers did last month' is three concrete imperatives, each answers 'what concretely'. No self-grading superlative, no number+retraction, no abstraction stack (grep 'most useful|one of the' → none).

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Internal dialect never lands on a slide.
rules_evaluated.evidence: No repo/authorial vocabulary in body L4-6; closest 'fresh evidence' (L4) is ordinary product-team English. grep compendium|firing|forcing function|beat|mood → none.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Emphasis budget — bold is for handles, and go very lightly.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Bold count in body = 0 (no ** in L1-6). Within budget.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Presence precedes content — verify against the composed deck, not long-read.
rules_evaluated.evidence: Slide file referenced from APT101 training module per maintainer STATUS (first in apt101-go-back-to-your-customers); signals slide_count=1; check-slide-size scanned it as a slide (1 slide). Not a phase-less prose section.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Numbering — position is computed, content ordinals are linted.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no Phase/Step headers or hand-numbered headings; check-slide-numbering --file → OK, exit 0

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Page geometry dies at the cut; reading order survives.
rules_evaluated.evidence: node scripts/check-slide-deixis.js --file curriculum/slides/customers-before-agents.md → OK, exit 0. Closest: L6 'start there' points at a named activity, not page position.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Slide size — 210 words / 6 bullets, and the cap is machine-checked.
Heading grammar is the mood switch, and it is load-bearing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L1 header is a claim ('Without customer contact, agents build your guesses faster'), the lecture/stance form the rule requires.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A bullet earns its slot or dies — three classes that read as rigour and carry nothing.
rules_evaluated.evidence: L6 'It is still where to start.' is the nearest to class (c) kicker: it restates the prior sentence's 'should start there'. Stays inside because it is one clause carrying the turn after the admission, and the maintainer block records it as the training's own stance, not a koan restating the header. Offered as a suggestion, not a gate. Classes (a) and (b) absent: L6 'That sells less of this training' is candour backed as claim sells-less, not design commentary on the pedagogy.

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: A retitled slide re-earns its bullets against the new header.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no header rename on record: git log shows one commit for the file, bullets written with header

rules_evaluated.rule_lead: Live-demo beats survive a text read.
rules_evaluated.na_reason: no guess/predict or demo beat in the chunk
